integrator_fixes: P10 status-pipe race (worker-V's finding, proven + fixed by integrator): Spawn used cmd.StdoutPipe with an eager cmd.Wait goroutine, and Go's Wait closes StdoutPipe read ends once the child exits — late collection on perfect fast-child behavior failed deterministically with 'file already closed' (proven by TestCollectAfterChildExit failing pre-fix). Spawn now uses a manual os.Pipe with owner-held lifetime (parent drops its write copy after Start; read end held until EOF/abort). All 11 consumer packages re-verified green
removed P14 helper's 1s status hold (the in-scope mitigation is no longer needed; the suite passing without it, happy in 0.09s, proves the P10 fix end-to-end) and corrected its stale comment

refuse() now passes the reserved cleanup-target path to the denial request: previously every refusal with a target misreported replaced-path (authority mismatch on empty path) and dropped the operative denial; pinned by TestRefuseCarriesDenialWithTarget
resource_and_cleanup_receipts: witness dirs, journals, leases, lanes, receipts in t.TempDir; every child reaped (Live()==0 asserted); orphan grandchild killed via pidfile + release re-probed; exact-image ps sweeps clean
no repo writes outside owned P14 paths + the integrator-owned P10 shared files
